subject: Re: Packaging options to reduce tier while retaining SmartTag & Rerank
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena@carewell.ai>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-09T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Packaging question — reduce tier but keep SmartTag & Rerank

Hi David,

We'd like to explore options to reduce our monthly commitment for Q3. Our usage has dropped ~30% and leadership is asking for a tighter package. The catch: SmartTag and Rerank are core to our product flow and we can't lose them.

Questions:
- Can SmartTag and Rerank be carved out as add-ons so we drop a tier but keep the features?
- If we downgrade, what is the expected impact on latency/throughput?
- Will we get prorated credits for unused committed capacity?

Attached a recent usage extract for May. Can you propose one or two concrete packaging paths and the commercial impact?

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call.

Elena
VP Product, CareWell Health
attachments: feature_usage_report.csv

From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Morales <elena@carewell.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-09T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Packaging question — reduce tier but keep SmartTag & Rerank

Elena — thanks for the note and the CSV. High-level answers below and a proposed next step.

Option A — Compact tier + feature add-ons\- Move CareWell from Throughput Tier to Compact (lower base commitment).
- Add SmartTag and Rerank as billable add-ons (flat monthly charge + small per-token increment).
- Expected latency: +10–20ms median for SmartTag if routed to Compact nodes; throughput reduced for peak bursts unless burst capacity retained.

Option B — Keep current tier but remove unused seats/features
- If there are unused seat credits, we can rebalance. This keeps latency unchanged but reduces headroom.

Commercial/proration
- We can prorate unused committed capacity and apply as a one-time credit toward the downgrade within the same billing period.

Immediate ask from our side
- Can you confirm: 1) peak concurrent tokens per minute for SmartTag flows, 2) monthly token volume for Rerank (approx)? That will let Karthik size the Compact addon and estimate latency/throughput delta.

Proposed next step: 30-minute workshop this week (tech + procurement + product) to run the tradeoffs and sign off on SOW amendment. I've looped in Karthik for sizing. I'll draft the amendment and a pilot credit proposal once we have the numbers.

Thanks,

—David
David Kim
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
redwood.ai | david.kim@redwood.ai

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elena Morales <elena@carewell.ai>
Date: 2026-05-10T08:33:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Packaging question — reduce tier but keep SmartTag & Rerank

David / Elena,

Quick technical note on the suggested addon path. If SmartTag stays on Compact nodes as an addon, we need to: 
- Reserve a small burst pool for prefix-heavy SmartTag requests (they keep KV cache warm). Without the pool, cold-starts will add ~80–120ms p95 to labeled flows.
- For Rerank: if Rerank runs with long candidate sets (>50) the Compact quantized execution path might push latency beyond SLA; we can apply a lightweight quantization profile for Rerank to preserve p95.

Sizing ask (Elena) — please provide a short sample of: peak concurrent requests, typical candidate set size for Rerank, and proportion of SmartTag calls that are prefix repeatable. That will let me propose exact burst capacity and the addon QPS thresholds.

I also recommend a 2-week pilot where we route 20% of production SmartTag traffic to the Compact addon to measure real delta before committing. Low risk and gives objective latency numbers.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Principal PM, Serving Runtime, Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elena Morales <elena@carewell.ai>
Date: 2026-05-10T14:11:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Packaging question — reduce tier but keep SmartTag & Rerank

Thanks for the plan. Commercials and quick practical offer from my side: 
- Offer structure: move CareWell to Compact tier (reduces monthly commit by ~38%). Keep SmartTag + Rerank as add-ons with a combined monthly addon fee of $3,000 plus per-token pricing.
- Pilot credit: provide a $5,000 one-time credit applied to the next invoice if CareWell agrees to a 30-day pilot routing 20% of SmartTag traffic to the Compact addon.
- Proration: we can prorate remaining committed tokens in the current invoice and apply as credit toward the Compact change (will show on the May invoice).

Attachment: draft SOW amendment (CareWell_SOW_v2.pdf) with implementation milestones and acceptance criteria.

If Procurement needs contract language for the credit/pilot, we can add a short amendment on top of the existing SOW. HubSpot deal updated: https://hubspot.redwood.com/deal/CW-2026-1492 (notes + pricing simulation).

If everyone is aligned I can prepare the commercial amendment (legal) and a short implementation checklist.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Director, Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
attachments: CareWell_SOW_v2.pdf

Thanks, team — this looks reasonable and we appreciate the pilot credit offer.

> On May 10, 2026, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai> wrote:
> > If everyone is aligned I can prepare the commercial amendment (legal) and a short implementation checklist.

We'd like to proceed with Option A (Compact + add-ons) and the 20% pilot for SmartTag. Two asks before we sign: 
1) A 30-minute technical kickoff this Thursday 5/13 — Elena + our SRE + David + Karthik. Can you confirm availability?
2) Please include a timeline in the SOW amendment: pilot start date (target 5/18), pilot end (2 weeks later), measurement gates, and rollback plan.

Procurement (cc) will follow up on the amendment language for the $5k credit. Please send the SOW amendment and implementation checklist to procurement@carewell.ai and I'll get internal approval flow started.

Best,
Elena
VP Product, CareWell Health
